testimonials.name: Asif Jehangir Reshi
testimonials.quote: Malus Lens has made the apple inspection process much easier for us. The reports are generated quickly and it helps us get a clearer picture of the quality of apples coming into our storage.

testimonials.name: Nadeem Parra
testimonials.quote: Earlier, checking the quality of incoming apples used to take considerable time. With Malus Lens, the process is much quicker and more organised. It is a useful addition to our operations.
testimonials.organisation: Orchard Fresh Cold Chain Pvt. Ltd.

testimonials.name: Mohsin Mir
testimonials.quote: What I liked about Malus Lens is that it provides a quick assessment along with a proper report. It has potential to make quality checking more systematic for cold-storage operators.
